tasks.spec:
You are a code-feature worker implementing Phase 3a (data foundation) of MonetaFox Reborn, a Microsoft Money replacement PWA. The repository is an existing, committed Vite + React 19 + TypeScript project at /home/user/Source/MonetaFoxReborn (the REPO). Read plan-reborn.md (Phase 3) and spec.md (Currency & Account Support, Transactions, Reports) first. Phase 1 already built the crypto layer at src/lib/crypto/ (deriveKey, encrypt/decrypt, and the EncryptedTable<T> Dexie wrapper) — REUSE it, do not reimplement it.

BOUNDARY / OWNERSHIP: Edit files directly in the REPO working tree. You OWN only: src/lib/db/** (create it), src/stores/** (create it), src/test/setup.ts (a small guard fix, see cleanup), and src/lib/crypto/CryptoStore.ts + src/lib/crypto/globalPolyfill.ts (cleanup only, see below). Do NOT modify src/App.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/components/**, src/lib/store.ts (the Phase 0 demo store — leave it; Phase 3b removes it), the four planning .md files, or anything under .ringer/. Do NOT add dependencies (dexie, zustand, fake-indexeddb are already installed). Do NOT git commit or push.

ARCHITECTURE (fixed decisions — follow exactly):
- Records are stored as WHOLE-RECORD ciphertext via the existing EncryptedTable: each Dexie table is keyed only by a string `id` (schema '&id'); all other fields live inside the encrypted blob. Queries decrypt in memory. Do not add plaintext secondary indexes.
- Primary keys are string UUIDs from crypto.randomUUID(); callers set `id` before add.
- The database is opened without a key; a CryptoKey is injected at UNLOCK time to build the encrypted repositories. This is the seam Phase 2 auth will call.

DELIVERABLE — implement with this EXACT public API (a hidden contract test pins these; drift fails it):

1. src/lib/db/models.ts — exported TypeScript interfaces for every entity in spec.md: Account (id, name, type, currency, archived?, createdAt), Transaction (id, accountId, date ISO string, amount number, currency, payee, categoryId?, notes?, tags?: string[], cleared?: boolean, reconciled?: boolean, splits?, type?), Category (id, name, parentId?, kind: 'income'|'expense'), Budget (id, categoryId, month 'YYYY-MM', limit number), ScheduledTransaction (id, recurrence, nextDate, mode: 'auto'|'manual', template fields), Asset (id, symbol, name, type), Holding (id, accountId, assetId, units), PricePoint (id, assetId, date, price), Settings (id, baseCurrency, encryptionMode). Also export an AccountType union covering at least checking, savings, credit, cash, investment, loan.

2. src/lib/db/database.ts — export class MonetaFoxDB extends Dexie with a Dexie.Table for each entity (accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, scheduledTransactions, assets, holdings, prices, settings), constructor(name = 'monetafox'), and a versioned schema where EVERY table's stores() definition is '&id' (only the id is indexed). Include version(1) and a comment noting how future migrations add versions.

3. src/lib/db/repository.ts — export interface Repositories with one EncryptedTable<T> per entity (accounts: EncryptedTable<Account>, transactions: EncryptedTable<Transaction>, categories, budgets, scheduledTransactions, assets, holdings, prices, settings). export function createRepositories(db: MonetaFoxDB, key: CryptoKey): Repositories that wraps each Dexie table in an EncryptedTable.

4. src/lib/db/index.ts — re-export MonetaFoxDB, createRepositories, Repositories, and all models.

5. src/stores/** — Zustand stores (zustand v5 `create`): useAccountStore, useTransactionStore, useCategoryStore, useBudgetStore, useSettingsStore, and a useUiStore (sidebar/modal/theme UI state, persisted via zustand/middleware persist). Each domain store: holds a nullable Repositories reference, exposes an `initialize(repos: Repositories)` action (called at unlock), an in-memory list of its entities, and async CRUD actions (load/add/update/remove) that delegate to its repository and refresh the in-memory list. Domain data must NEVER be persisted in plaintext (only uiStore uses persist). Export a helper, e.g. src/stores/index.ts `initializeStores(repos: Repositories)`, that calls initialize on every domain store — the single seam Phase 2 will invoke after deriving the key.

6. Comprehensive Vitest tests: src/lib/db/*.test.ts (encrypted round-trip + ciphertext-at-rest, using `// @vitest-environment node`, `import 'fake-indexeddb/auto'`, and a real key from deriveKey) and src/stores/*.test.ts (store CRUD against a real MonetaFoxDB). Assertions must be real.

7. CARRIED-OVER CLEANUP (from Phase 1): This phase legitimately owns the test infra, so fix the workaround properly:
   - Edit src/test/setup.ts so its afterEach only touches localStorage/document when those globals exist (guard with `typeof ... !== 'undefined'`, like the existing matchMedia guard).
   - DELETE src/lib/crypto/globalPolyfill.ts and remove the `import './globalPolyfill';` line from src/lib/crypto/CryptoStore.ts.
   - Confirm the crypto suite still passes after removal.

HOW TO VERIFY before finishing (from REPO root): `corepack pnpm run typecheck`, `corepack pnpm run test`, `corepack pnpm run lint`, `corepack pnpm run build` — all must exit 0.

OUTPUT CONTRACT: make the changes in owned paths, then write ./notes.md in your task dir: what you read, files created/changed, commands run with results, the entity/schema decisions, how the key-injection unlock seam works (for Phase 2), and any assumption or follow-up.

HARD RULES: match the API signatures exactly; reuse Phase 1 crypto; whole-record encryption only (no plaintext secondary indexes); never persist domain data in plaintext; keep it typed and boring; do not touch files outside ownership; do not commit.
tasks.verified: A hidden data-layer contract test passes (encrypted Dexie round-trip, ciphertext-at-rest for accounts and transactions, wrong-key rejection); the data layer uses EncryptedTable with '&id' schemas and string-UUID keys; Zustand stores for accounts/transactions/categories/budgets/settings/ui exist with an initialize(repos) unlock seam; the Phase 1 polyfill is removed and setup.ts is guarded with the crypto contract test STILL passing; and typecheck + suite + lint + build all exit 0. Only owned paths changed; nothing committed.
